title: 呈现路由
summary: 同一轮回答在纯文本、契约组件和 iframe 沙盒里各长什么样；名字或 props 不合法时宿主在原位报错，半截 JSON 先等闭合。
summaryEn: How one turn looks as plain text, a contract component, or an iframe sandbox. An illegal name or props stay an in-place error, and unclosed JSON waits.
asks: 这一轮该用纯文本、契约组件，还是 iframe 沙盒？坏包怎么报错？
asksEn: Should this turn be plain text, a contract component, or an iframe sandbox — and how does a bad packet surface as an error?

links.when: 助手住在哪，不是这一轮用哪种表面来呈现
links.whenEn: where the assistant lives is not which surface this turn renders on

links.when: 半截包是未闭合的路由 JSON，不是语音 token 的打字机
links.whenEn: a partial packet is an unclosed route JSON object, not a speech-token typewriter
